verdict.rationale: A direct probe got HTTP 200 at https://workos.com/openapi.json, and the response contains an "openapi" key. That is hands-on confirmation of a publicly downloadable OpenAPI spec. Machine-readable docs (llms.txt, docs.md) are also served, which supports the same AI-native workflow. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or linking the spec, and evidence of its coverage, version, or completeness against the full API.
